judgments.reason: The eLife paper reports the same 9-lab pre-registered N400 replication of DeLong et al. (2005) by the same authors; it is the study paper for this EEG data.
judgments.paper_title: Large-scale replication study reveals a limit on probabilistic prediction in language comprehension

judgments.reason: MNE-BIDS is a software tool for organizing electrophysiological data into BIDS; it is not a paper describing the N400 replication dataset.
judgments.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
judgments.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software

judgments.reason: EEG-BIDS is a specification/extension of BIDS for organizing EEG data, a standard the dataset uses, not a paper describing the N400 multi-site replication data.
judgments.paper_title: EEG-BIDS, an extension to the brain imaging data structure for electroencephalography
